verses.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.sm: O taulaga na faia e Elia ma perofeta a Paala, e iloa ai le Atua moni Elia i le tolu o tausaga, ua faapea mai, Ina alu ia oe, ma faaali oe ia Aapo, ou te faatotóina foi le ua i le laueleele.

verses.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o Elia e faaali o ia ia Aapo; sa matuá velavela le oge i Samaria.

verses.en: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
verses.sm: Na valaau foi Aapo ia Opetaia, o le pwe i lona aiga. (Sa matuā mata‘u Opetaia i le ALII;

verses.en: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.sm: auà na fasiotia e Iesepela o perofeta a le ALII, ona ave lea e Opetaia o perofeta e toaselau, ma nana ia te i latou e taitoalimagafulu i ana, na ia fafaga foi ia te i latou i areto ma vai.)

verses.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Aapo ia Opetaia, Ina alu ia oe i le nuu i vaipuna uma, atoa foi ma alia uma; pe tatou te maua ni mutia e faaolaina ai solofanua, ma falata, ina ne“ maumau manu uma.

verses.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.sm: Ona vaeluaina lea e i laua o le nuu, ina ia la feoai ai; ua alu Aapo ile tasi ala na o ia, a ua alu Opetaia i le isi ala na o ia.

verses.en: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.sm: Ua i ai i le ala Opetaia, faauta, ua la fetaiai ma Elia; ua iloa o ia e ia ona ѓaapauѓa6 ai lea o ia, ua faapea mai, O oe ea le alii o Elia?

verses.en: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o ia, o aʻu lava lea. Alu ia oe, ma e fai atu i lou alii, Faauta, o Elia.

verses.en: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia, Se a ea se mea ua ou agasala ai, ina a e tuuina atu ai lau auauna i le lima o Aapo, ia fasiotia ai aʻu?

verses.en: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.sm: O loo soifua le ALII lou Atua, E leai se nuu po o se malo e lei oo i ai le feau a loʻu alii e sailiili ia te oe; a latou tali mai ai, E le i ai, ona ia fai atu lea, e tauto lea malo ma lea nuu, ua latou le maua oe.

verses.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua e fetalai mai, Alu ia oe ma e fai atu i lou alii, Faauta, o Elia.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
verses.sm: A aʻu alu ese ia te oe, Ona avea lea o oe e le Agaga o le ALII i se mea ou te le iloa; pe a ou alu, ma taʻu atu ia Aapo, a e le maua mai oe e ia, ona fasiotia lea o au e ia; a o loo mataʻu lau auauna i le ALII talu ina ou itiiti.

verses.en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.sm: Pe na le ta‘uina atu ea i lo‘u alii le mea na ou faia ina ua fasiotia e Iesepela o perofeta a le ALII; na ou natia perofeta a le ALII, O tagata e toaselau, e taitoalimagafulu i ana, na ou fafaga foi ia te i latou i areto ma vai?

verses.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ua e fetalai mai, Alu ia ce, ma e fai atu i lou alii, Faauta, o Elia; cna fasiotia lea o aʻu e ia.

verses.en: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia, O loo soifua le ALII o “au, o ia ou te tu ai i ona luma, ou te faaali lava aʻu ia te ia i le aso nei.

verses.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o Opetaia e faafetaiai ia Aapo, ma ta'u atu ai ia te la; ona sau ai lea o Aapo e faafetaiai ia Elia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e Aapo ia Elia, ona fai atu lea o Aapo ia te ia, O oe ea o lë faatiga ia Isaraelu?

verses.en: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o ia, E le o aʻu lē faatiga ia Isaraelu, a o oe ma le aiga o lou tamá; auá ua outou tuua O poloaiga a le Aw, ma outou mulimuli atu ia Paala.

verses.en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina feau atu la, ma faapotopoto mai ia te au i le mauga o Karamelu o Isaraelu uma, ma perofeta a Paala e fa selau ma le lima o sefulu, ma perofeta a Asaira e fa selau, o e aai i le laulau a Iesepela.

verses.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.sm: Ona feauina atu lea e Aapo i le fanauga uma a Isaraelu, ua ia faapotopoto foi le au perofeta i le mauga o Karamelu.

verses.en: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.sm: Ona faalatalata atu lea o Elia i le nuu uma, ua faapea atu, Pe tou te faaletonu i manatu e lua seia afea? Afai o le ALII O le Atua ia, ia outou mulimuli atu ia te iaja e afai o Paala, ia outou mulimuli atu ia te ia. A e le tali mai le nuu ia te ia i se upu.

verses.en: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia i le nuu, Ua na o aʻu ua toe i perofeta a le ALII; a o perofeta a Paala, e fa selau ma le toalimagafulu i latou.

verses.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.sm: la latou au mai ia te i matou o povi e lua; ona filifilia lea e i latou se tasi povi mo i latou, ma latou pena, ma faaee ai i luga o fafie, a e aua le avane ai le afi; ou te saunia foi le tasi povi, ma faaee ai i luga o fafie, a ou te le avane ai le afi.

verses.en: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.sm: Ona valaau atu lea outou i le igoa o outou atua; ou te valaau atu foi i le suafa o le ALII. O le Atua na te tali mai i le afi, o le Atua lea. Ona tali mai lea o le nuu uma, ua faapea mai, Ua lelei lau upu.

verses.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia i perofeta a Paala, Ina filifili ia se povi mo outou, ma ja muamua ona sauni ai e outou, auá e toatele owon; ia outou valaau atu foi i le igoa o outou atua, a e aua le avane ai le afi.

verses.en: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.sm: Ona latou avea lea o le povi na tuuina atu ia te i latou, ua latou saunia foi, ma latou valaau atu i le igoa o Paala, na amata i le taeao ua 00 i le tutonu o le la, ua faapea atu, Paala e, ia e faafogafoga mai ia te i matou. A ua leai se leo; e leai se na tali mai. Ona latou feosofi lea i le fata faitaulaga na latou faia.

verses.en: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le tutonu o le la, ona tauemu atu lea o Elia ia te i latou, ua ia faapea atu, Ina valaau atu ia, ia leo tele; aua O le atua ia; po ua tautala ia, po ua alu ese, po ua alu i se malaga; ai lava ua moe ia, e tatau ona fagufagu atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.sm: Ona latou valaau atu lea ua leo tele, ma latou selei ia te i latou i polo ma tui, e tusa ma la latou tu, ua co ina faamaligiina ifo le toto ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.sm: Ua mavae le tutonu o le la, ona latou perofeta ane lea ua oo i le itu la e fai ai le taulaga afiafi, a ua leai se leo, e leai se na tali mai, pe faalogo mai.

verses.en: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia i le nuu uma, Ina faalatalata mai ia ia te au. Ona faalatalata atu lea o le nuu uma ia te ia, ona toe teu lea e ia o le fata faitaulaga o le ALI sa sóloia i lalo.

verses.en: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e Elia o maa e sefulu ma le lua, e tusa ma le faitauina o itu aiga o atalii o Iakopo, o le na oo i ai le afioga a le ALII, na faapea, E igoa oe ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e ia i ia maa o le fata faitaulaga i le suafa o le ALI; ua faia foi e ia le utu ua soo ai le fata faitaulaga; o lona tele ua tusa ma sea e lua o fua.

verses.en: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.sm: Ona faaafu lea e ia o fafie, ma pena le povi, ma faaee ai i luga o fafie; ona fai atu lea O ia, Ina faatutu mai ia O kate e fa i le vai, ma sasaa ai i luga o le taulaga mu, ma luga o fafie.

verses.en: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu foi, Ina foi faalua mai ia. Ona latou foi faalua mai ai lea. Ua ia fai atu foi, Ina foi faatolu mai ia. Ona latou foi faatolu mai ai lea.

verses.en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.sm: Ua tafe le vai ua soo ai le fata faitaulaga; ua tumu foi le utu i le vai.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le itu la e fai ai le taulaga afiafi, ona faalatalata atu ai lea o Elia le perofeta, ua faapea atu, Le ALII e, le Atua o Aperaamo, ma Isaako, ma Isaraelu, ia faailoa i lenei aso, o oe o le Atua i Isaraelu, o aʻu foi o lau auauna, ma ua ou faia O nei mea uma e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.sm: la e faafofoga mai ia te au, le ALI e, ia e faafofoga mai ia te au, ina ia iloa e le nuu nei o ce o le ALII o le Atua, ma ua e faaliliuina mai o latou loto.

verses.en: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.sm: Ona pau ifo lea o le afi a le ALII, ma faaumatia ai le taulaga mu, ma fafie, ma maa, ma le eleele ua mitiia ai foi le vai sa i le utu.

verses.en: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le nuu uma, ona faapauufao ai lea o i latou, ua faapea, O le ALI, o le Atua ia; o le ALII o le Atua ia!

verses.en: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia ia te i latou, Ia outou pupue i perofeta a Paala; aua ne“ sao atu so latou. Ona latou pupue lea ia te i latou; ua ave ifo foi e Elia ia te i latou i le alia o Kisona, ma na fasioti ia te i latou i lea mea.

verses.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elia ia Aapo, Ina maliu ae ia oe, ia e taumafa ma inu; aua o le taalili o le ua tele.

verses.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.sm: Ona alu ae ai lea o Aapo e ‘ai ma inu; ua alu ae foi Elia i le tumutumu o Karamelu, ua ia ifo ai i le eleele, ma tuu ona mata i le va o ona tulivae.

verses.en: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu ia i lana auauna, Ia e alu ae, ma vaavaai i tai. Ona alu ae lea o ia, ma ia vaavaai, ua faapea mai, E leai se mea. Ona fai atu lea o ia, Ina foi faafitu atu ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verses.sm: 44!ratami, faauta mai, o le agelu ua Ua oo i lona foi faafitu, ona ia fai mai lea, Faauta, ua alu ae i le sami si ao itiiti e pei o se alofilima o se tagata. Ona fai atu lea o ia, Ina alu ae ia, ma e fai atu ia Aapo, Ina sauni ia lou nofoa faataavalevale, ma e maliu ifo, ne“ taofia oe i le uaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.sm: O loo fai foi ia mea, ua faamalumalu ifo le lagi i ao ma le savili; ua tele lava le timu. Ua tietie Aapo i le nofoa faataavalevale, ma alu i Isereelu.

verses.en: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.sm: Sa ia Elia le aao o le AL11; ona fusi ai lea o ia i lona sulugatiti, ma tamoe i luma o Aapo, ua 00 i le mea e ui atu ai i
